_doc: Corner lots in the generated town (map 0, seed 1; the lots tests/core/lot_site_test.gd lists): two houses facing the same street either side of a side street, each with its side garden, front boundary and composed side facade on the side street; and flats on the corners of a side street nearer the middle. setView: [x, y, zoom, azimuth, elevation], y the map's north (our -z); the azimuth puts the camera at +x at 0 and +z at 90.
